title: Absolute finite-field Frobenius is a universal homeomorphism without a finite-type hypothesis
statement: Fix the finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $T$ be any $k_0$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-over-base], with no finite-type or separatedness assumption. The absolute $q$-power Frobenius $F_T^{(q)}:T\to T$ [def-weil-absolute-frobenius-scheme], the identity on the space and $s\mapsto s^q$ on the structure sheaf, is a universal homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism].
